[⬇ Download all lectures as one PDF](../downloads/advpchem-lecture-notes.pdf){.btn .btn-primary .btn-sm download="advpchem-lecture-notes.pdf"}

Each chapter covers one lecture in more detail than there is time for in
class. Read it before (or right after) the lecture. Each one ends with key points and
study questions, and has a printable PDF version under *Other Formats*.

The first six lectures build the theory. Lectures 1–3 approximate the **wave
function** (basis sets) and come before Experiment 1. Lectures 4–6 approximate the
**Hamiltonian** (Hartree–Fock and density functional theory) and come before
Experiment 2. From Lecture 7 on, each lecture looks back at the experiment you just
finished and prepares the next one.

::: {.callout-note}
## Debrief sections
From Lecture 7 on, the first part of each chapter discusses the results of the previous
experiment. Read it **after** you submit that experiment. Your predictions are
more useful if they're your own.
:::
